answer: Give every identity an expiry date: standing must be renewed by passing a fresh, unpredictable capability and honesty exam each cycle, graded by randomly drawn peers. A newcomer enters through one narrow inlet and earns only a small quota; the quota grows only with clean renewals. Think of the record as an onyx ledger, hard to fake and easy to check, and let one agent's good standing bridge to new services only after its latest exam passes. A Sybil swarm then pays the exam cost again and again for every fake, while honest agents pay once.
